comparison: Stock Yamux versus native Tokio Veyrmux through two actual proxies and a local TCP echo service.

method.aggregate: median of four independent per-block median point estimates per arm
method.confidence: 95% bootstrap intervals retained per block; no aggregate CI or p99 claim
method.controls: legacy cases do not use either multiplexer
method.network_isolation: fresh loopback-only network namespace per block; unprivileged benchmark; zero listener-drop, SYN-retransmission and kernel-timeout deltas; all data-retransmission counts retained without filtering blocks
method.pilot_policy: all pilots, shared-namespace timings and kernel diagnostics excluded
method.runtime_overrides: none; fixed 65536 process file-descriptor budget; no affinity, allocator or global sysctl changes
method.scope: sequential complete application TCP request lifecycle: connect, payload write, local write-half shutdown, exact echo and peer EOF; one-second request deadline; not maximum service throughput
method.timing: Criterion estimates exclude fixture setup and teardown; process times/resources retained separately

publication_boundary: Only sanitized numeric samples, relative source hashes and methodology; no execution endpoints, private paths, controllers or raw operational traces.

validation.eof_mutation: Removing client half-close made the request fail at its deadline.
